data.name: Sample - CrowdSec Cyber Threat Intelligence - 1.0.0
data.description: Integrates CrowdSec's CTI and Service APIs to provide IP reputation analysis, threat intelligence lookup, and automated security list management. Enables investigation of malicious IPs, blocklist/allowlist operations, and firewall integration for threat response.
